prompt: NewCo reported EBITDA of $8,400,000 for FY3. As part of a Quality-of-Earnings review you assess management's proposed normalizations. The following items require adjustment: (1) the founder's compensation exceeded a market-rate replacement salary by $650,000 (excess owner compensation, add back); (2) a one-time legal settlement of $1,200,000 was expensed during the year (non-recurring, add back); (3) $375,000 of non-recurring consulting and restructuring fees were incurred for a failed acquisition (add back); (4) reported revenue included a $900,000 one-time government relief grant that will not recur (deduct); and (5) a product line discontinued before year-end contributed $540,000 of EBITDA that will not exist going forward (deduct). Starting from reported EBITDA and applying all five adjustments, compute normalized EBITDA.
